server_arguments.name: backend
server_arguments.label: backend
server_arguments.desc: Model backend. 'auto' prefers the SGLang native implementation and falls back to diffusers; 'sglang' forces the native optimized path; 'diffusers' runs the vanilla diffusers pipeline.

server_arguments.name: trust_remote_code
server_arguments.label: trust-remote-code
server_arguments.desc: Trust remote code when loading HuggingFace models.

server_arguments.name: resolution
server_arguments.label: resolution
server_arguments.desc: Override the selected pipeline config's resolution. Only applies to pipelines that define a resolution field.

server_arguments.name: flow_shift
server_arguments.label: flow-shift
server_arguments.desc: Flow shift parameter for the sampling schedule.

server_arguments.name: performance_mode
server_arguments.label: performance-mode
server_arguments.desc: Preset for performance and memory defaults. 'manual' leaves performance args under explicit control; 'auto' keeps safe defaults plus high-confidence FSDP/CFG improvements; 'speed' favors GPU-resident execution for lower latency and may OOM; 'memory' favors lower GPU memory usage. Explicit offload/FSDP/parallelism flags take precedence.

server_arguments.name: enable_torch_compile
server_arguments.label: enable-torch-compile
server_arguments.desc: Compile the transformer with torch.compile. Increases startup time in exchange for faster steps.

server_arguments.name: regional_compile
server_arguments.label: regional-compile
server_arguments.desc: Compile repeated DiT submodules selected by the model's _compile_conditions instead of the whole transformer. Requires enable-torch-compile.

server_arguments.name: dit_precision
server_arguments.label: dit-precision
server_arguments.desc: Precision for the DiT model.

server_arguments.name: vae_precision
server_arguments.label: vae-precision
server_arguments.desc: Precision for the VAE.

server_arguments.name: image_encoder_precision
server_arguments.label: image-encoder-precision
server_arguments.desc: Precision for the image encoder.

server_arguments.name: warmup_mode
server_arguments.label: warmup-mode
server_arguments.desc: Warmup mode. 'off' disables warmup; 'request' warms on real incoming requests; 'server' issues a synthetic warmup request once the server is ready, before traffic. sglang serve defaults to 'server'.

server_arguments.name: warmup_steps
server_arguments.label: warmup-steps
server_arguments.desc: Number of warmup steps to perform for each resolution.

server_arguments.name: sp_degree
server_arguments.label: sp-degree
server_arguments.desc: Sequence parallelism size. If unset, uses all remaining GPUs after accounting for TP and DP.

server_arguments.name: use_fsdp_inference
server_arguments.label: use-fsdp-inference
server_arguments.desc: Shard DiT weights across GPUs with FSDP. For single-GPU memory pressure prefer CPU or layerwise offload.

server_arguments.name: dit_cpu_offload
server_arguments.label: dit-cpu-offload
server_arguments.desc: Use CPU offload for DiT inference. Enable when running out of memory with FSDP.

server_arguments.name: dit_layerwise_offload
server_arguments.label: dit-layerwise-offload
server_arguments.desc: Layerwise CPU offload with async host-to-device prefetch overlap for DiTs. Cannot be combined with use-fsdp-inference; takes precedence over the other DiT offload flags.

server_arguments.name: vae_cpu_offload
server_arguments.label: vae-cpu-offload
server_arguments.desc: Use CPU offload for the VAE. Enable when running out of memory.

server_arguments.name: text_encoder_cpu_offload
server_arguments.label: text-encoder-cpu-offload
server_arguments.desc: Use CPU offload for the text encoder. Enable when running out of memory.

server_arguments.name: image_encoder_cpu_offload
server_arguments.label: image-encoder-cpu-offload
server_arguments.desc: Use CPU offload for the image encoder. Enable when running out of memory.

server_arguments.name: pin_cpu_memory
server_arguments.label: pin-cpu-memory
server_arguments.desc: Pin host memory for CPU offload. Should stay enabled in almost all cases; disable only as a workaround for 'CUDA error: invalid argument'.

server_arguments.name: vae_tiling
server_arguments.label: vae-tiling
server_arguments.desc: Enable VAE tiling.

server_arguments.name: vae_slicing
server_arguments.label: vae-slicing
server_arguments.desc: Enable VAE slicing.

server_arguments.name: batching_mode
server_arguments.label: batching-mode
server_arguments.desc: Request batching scheduler mode. Only 'dynamic' is implemented.

server_arguments.name: batching_max_size
server_arguments.label: batching-max-size
server_arguments.desc: Maximum number of compatible generation requests to merge into one batch.

server_arguments.name: batching_delay_ms
server_arguments.label: batching-delay-ms
server_arguments.desc: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a larger batch to form before dispatch.

server_arguments.name: quantization
server_arguments.label: quantization
server_arguments.desc: Quantization method for the transformer. Auto-detected from the checkpoint when omitted. Online quantization from a BF16/FP16 checkpoint supports 'fp8' and 'mxfp4'; the other methods require a pre-quantized checkpoint.

server_arguments.name: quantization_precision
server_arguments.label: quantization-precision
server_arguments.desc: Override the precision used by the selected quantization method.

server_arguments.name: enable_svdquant
server_arguments.label: enable-svdquant
server_arguments.desc: Enable Nunchaku SVDQuant (W4A4-style) inference.

server_arguments.name: enable_batching_metrics
server_arguments.label: enable-batching-metrics
server_arguments.desc: Log periodic batch efficiency metrics such as realized batch size and queue wait time. The diffusion backend exposes no /metrics endpoint, so this only writes to the server log.

server_arguments.name: enable_cache_report
server_arguments.label: enable-cache-report
server_arguments.desc: Return the number of cached tokens in usage.prompt_tokens_details on OpenAI-compatible responses.

arguments.name: n
arguments.label: n
arguments.desc: The number of images to generate.

arguments.name: size
arguments.label: size
arguments.desc: The size of the generated images.

arguments.name: num_inference_steps
arguments.label: num_inference_steps
arguments.desc: Number of denoising steps.

arguments.name: guidance_scale
arguments.label: guidance_scale
arguments.desc: Classifier-free guidance scale. Higher values follow the prompt more closely.

arguments.name: true_cfg_scale
arguments.label: true_cfg_scale
arguments.desc: True CFG scale, for models that distinguish guidance distillation from real CFG (e.g. Qwen-Image).

arguments.name: negative_prompt
arguments.label: negative_prompt
arguments.desc: Prompt describing what to exclude from the generated image.

arguments.name: seed
arguments.label: seed
arguments.desc: Random seed for reproducible generations.

arguments.name: response_format
arguments.label: response_format
arguments.desc: Format of the returned images.

arguments.name: output_format
arguments.label: output_format
arguments.desc: Encoding of the returned image file.

arguments.name: background
arguments.label: background
arguments.desc: Background handling for models that support transparency.

arguments.name: quality
arguments.label: quality
arguments.desc: Requested output quality.

arguments.name: max_sequence_length
arguments.label: max_sequence_length
arguments.desc: Maximum prompt sequence length passed to the text encoder.

arguments.name: flow_shift
arguments.label: flow_shift
arguments.desc: Per-request flow shift override for the sampling schedule.

arguments.name: enable_teacache
arguments.label: enable_teacache
arguments.desc: Enable TeaCache step reuse for faster generation.

arguments.desc: Upscale the generated image after denoising.
